Algeria, China and the Russian Federation abstained."}, {"id": "action", "text": "Operative paragraph 1 of resolution 2739 extends the Secretary-General’s reporting request under paragraph 10 of resolution 2722 (2024) until 15 January 2025. It urges caution, restraint and diplomatic efforts. The adopted text contains no new authorization of military action or expansion of the reporting authority."}], "notes": [{"speaker": "United States and Japan sponsors’ desk", "text": "Council 27 June 2024: Draft S/2024/500 adopted as Res. 2739 (12-0-3). Positions overlapped on reporting extension but differed on Houthi cessation demands"}, {"speaker": "Algeria record desk", "text": "The sponsors supported extending reporting to 15 January 2025 to track Houthi attacks on commerce. Algeria abstained, citing concerns over implementation of resolution 2722 and misuse of self-defence. While sponsors and Algeria agreed on the reporting extension, they differed on the demand for Houthi cessation of attacks on merchant vessels."}]}
